+title: Merge the AgentViewKitACP target into AgentViewKit
+---
+## What
+The owner decided on one library product (update.md §3, D4). Move the ACP adapter files into the `AgentViewKit` target. `AgentViewKit` then links FoundationModelsACP and FoundationModelsACPClient directly.
+
+- [ ] Move the files of `Sources/AgentViewKitACP/` to `Sources/AgentViewKit/ACP/`. Merge `AgentViewKitACPModule.swift` into `AgentViewKitModule.swift`. Two `ProcessLauncher.swift` files exist (`Sources/AgentViewKitACP/` and `Sources/AgentViewKit/Platform/`): rename the ACP one to `AgentProcessLauncher.swift`.
+- [ ] Move `Tests/AgentViewKitACPTests/` into `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/ACP/`. Merge the test target dependencies (`DemoSupport`, `PackageFileSupport`, the two ACP products).
+- [ ] In `Package.swift`: remove the `AgentViewKitACP` product, target and test target. Add the `FoundationModelsACP` and `FoundationModelsACPClient` products to `AgentViewKit`. Remove `AgentViewKitACP` from `DemoSupport` and `ReadmeSnippetsTests`. Change the comments.
+- [ ] Remove `import AgentViewKitACP` from `Examples/ReadmeSnippets/Snippets/*`, `README.md`, `Examples/AgentViewKitDemo/` and `generate_xcodeproj.rb`. Make the Xcode project and the snippets again.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `Package.swift` has exactly one library product: `AgentViewKit`.
+- [ ] No file imports `AgentViewKitACP`.
+- [ ] `swift test`, `Scripts/check-readme.sh` and `Scripts/test-examples.sh AgentViewKitDemo` pass.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/PackageStructureTests/ManifestTests.swift`: assert one library product, `AgentViewKit`, and that it links `FoundationModelsACP`, `FoundationModelsACPClient` and the EditorKit products.
+- [ ] `Tests/PackageStructureTests/ImportBoundaryTests.swift`: the new rule is that no target imports `FoundationModels`, `FoundationModelsRouter` or `FoundationModelsExtras`. Remove the old rule that `AgentViewKit` imports no source runtime.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
